2239-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2239-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

907-1479-8337.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2557-7282-8160.easyPrerequisites:
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
2557-7282-8160.description:
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Parallel Lives.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4.
2557-7282-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

3652-5006-8170-8227.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-5006-8170-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
3652-5006-8170-8227.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Loot by sacrificing Ornithopter, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

513-3558-4336.easyPrerequisites: One of the creatures with mana cost {0} must be in your hand with the other being on the battlefield.
513-3558-4336.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other creature with mana cost {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

147-4247-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4247-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
728-6872--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

648-1880-6854--147.manaNeeded: {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
648-1880-6854--147.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-1880-6854--147.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield.
Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Hallar equal to the number the Fractal had.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

413-628-7865.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Dream Seizer trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1778-4336-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-4336-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5147-6255.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3185-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3185-3967-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

772-3175-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

6636-7257.easyPrerequisites: You haven't flipped a coin this turn.
6636-7257.description:
Cast Squee's Revenge by paying {1}{U}{R}. Choose a number equal to at most half your deck size, rounded down.
Resolve Squee's Revenge, winning all flips due to Edgar and drawing twice that many cards.
6636-7257.notes: If your deck size is even, you can draw your entire library. If it's odd, you'll have at least one card remaining.

338-2034-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2034-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2026-4222-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.

549-3259-5953-6968.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

465-3817-5686.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

869-1987-2585-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

654-5702-5954-6753.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-5702-5954-6753.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-5702-5954-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Amulet of Vigor each trigger twice.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the lands.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

813-2103-5530.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Another Round.
813-2103-5530.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1479-3861-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3861-6529.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-5430-6488.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1775-5430-6488.description:
Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Jaya, Venerated Firemage.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Jaya, Venerated Firemage.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Jaya, Venerated Firemage.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1775-5430-6488.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

801-2393-5173-5626.notablePrerequisites: One of Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
801-2393-5173-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

413-1003-5220-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

774-3470-3756.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2080-4050-5913.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-4050-5913.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

225-1682-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-1682-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

3000-5670-5931.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-5931.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room // Awakening Hall triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

5779-5782.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toxrill's first ability triggers, putting a slime counter on each creature your opponents control.
Because your opponents' creatures are now 0/0 due to Maha and Toxrill's static effects, the creatures die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness unless there is an effect boosting their toughness.
Repeat during each of your end steps.

4179-5610.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Hydra Omnivore.
You have a way to increase Hydra Omnivore's power by 1 or more, or each opponent has at least one poison counter.
4179-5610.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1, trample and infect until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Hydra Omnivore, causing them to get at least nine poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Hydra Omnivore triggers, causing each other opponent to get at least nine poison counters.
Each remaining opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

1274-2060-2926-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Traveling Minister does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Traveling Minister.
1274-2060-2926-4222.description:
Activate Traveling Minister by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life and giving target creature +1/+0 until end of turn.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Traveling Minister.
Repeat.

1263-2178-2661-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Gwenna.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has attacked this turn.
1263-2178-2661-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
Bloodsoaked Champion dies, triggering Gwenna, untapping Gwenna.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Bloodsoaked Champion's power.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-2060-3048.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Roalesk.
1409-2060-3048.description:
Activate Roalesk by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Roalesk enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Roalesk trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Roalesk.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

57-1151-1402-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-1151-1402-2178.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff and Stalking Vengeance both trigger.
Resolve the Stalking Vengeance trigger, dealing damage equal to Diamond Lion's power to any target.
Resolve the Thornbite Staff trigger, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.
